headline: Grigoriy Zatravkin surges to 10th on ARC-3

sections.text: Grigoriy Zatravkin gained 14.57 points to reach 40.63, vaulting from 1,274th to 10th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb puts him in the board's 18 gold places, after rising from 1,274th.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
